records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Good to see Granite Ventures has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Ventures
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account created first project on day 3 (as_of day 6), showing real engagement, but no key_milestone and no invites sent, and no reply to either Wrenfield email [email:06c28eb1], [email:d948787e]. Pro plan and 8 days left leave room, but silence plus solo usage lowers odds.

draft.subject: Next step for your Granite Ventures project
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Following up on my note last week — your first project is up, which is the main thing. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work into that project is usually the step that makes it click.

If it would help, I'm happy to spend 20 minutes with you this week walking through how you've structured it and what to add next. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Nadia
